difficulty_reason: The algorithm uses interval-specific normal forms and a preorder of localised Hom spaces to remove the exhaustive subspace search needed for general multiparameter modules. The author then bounds pairwise Hom computations, graph condensation and all reduced matrix operations to obtain cubic complexity. This is a distinct substantive algorithmic improvement over the general structural exact-sequence theorem.
